title: Check actual test output paths before execution
procedure: Before launching a test command, inspect the selected tests and helper functions, resolve generated output roots against the actual checkout, and reserve every resolved path. Assert output roots remain under the intended worktree. A broad package test may execute additional writers beyond the selected leaf. Git scope checks do not discover every ignored or outside-checkout output. On a deviation, stop further writes, retain evidence, correct the path or reservation prospectively, and do not treat a later claim as retrospective authorization. This procedure is advisory and grants no authority.
